text:
hannah: Quick check-in 1 — final draft for the Product Launch blog is up on preview. Need a rapid copy + benchmark sanity check before we send to legal. Aim: publish Thu 9am PT.

jude: I'll do headline + benchmark wording. Link please?

hannah: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1718012345 — focus on hero copy, benchmark blurb, and CTA UTMs.

maya: Hero suggestion: 'Predictable LLM inference at production scale' — keeps it technical but customer-facing.

jude: For the benchmark: avoid over-precision. Proposed: 'In Dedicated tests we observed sustained token throughput and median latency under 100ms on representative prompts.' Add a parenthetical for test config.

ton y: tiny nit: "under 100ms" ok with product? Might trigger legal if we imply guarantee.

maya: Good catch. Change to 'median latency near 100ms' or 'sub-100ms typical median latency' to soften.

jude: I'll edit to "median latency typically near 100ms" and include: "(test config: 8xA100, seq_len=512, mixed-batch workloads)"

hannah: Ops: can you confirm UTMs + HubSpot fields for both CTA and webinar form? We need server-side tag for direct CTA clicks.

ops-bot: Suggested UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=prod_launch_q2_2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=prod_launch_q2_2026, lead_source=blog, product_interest=dedicated. We'll implement server-side tagging for direct link clicks.

legal: Quick flag: avoid words like 'guarantee' or 'always'. Also add privacy note near webinar form: 'We process your data per our Privacy Policy.' I can do a 15-min pass once copy updated.

hannah: Nice. I'll swap benchmark phrasing and add the privacy line, then tag @legal. Also adding a placeholder customer quote block to help layout.

maya: Visuals: I'll prep the hero banner and a compact benchmark chart. Need final copy in 90 minutes.

jude: SEO micro: include 'dedicated inference' and 'inference latency' in subhead + meta.

hannah: Done. Edited draft and pushed to preview. Tagging @legal now.

legal: Received — will review in 20.

hannah: Thanks all — plan: legal pass this afternoon, ops wire UTMs and server-tags, schedule Thu 9am PT. :rocket:
